session_logs_access: READ ONLY — moderator_log.json only; nothing written

unresolved_runs.rule: a run is NOT segmented unless every one of Q1-Q5 is anchored to a transition that actually poses that question; positional acceptance is never used as a fallback

reconciliation_rule: included_Q1_to_Q5_words + excluded_closing_residue_words == comparable_window_words; the residue is never absorbed into Q5

boundary_ambiguity.note: All 30 runs are anchored by the latest explicit guide-question ask. The two formerly ambiguous opening turns are resolved by the binding researcher-reviewed boundaries; no positional fallback is used.

boundary_provenance.method: literal `Question N.` moderator header
